strings.name: Fan Zhendong
strings.summary: Fan developed through Guangzhou youth training into China’s national team, becoming known for quick transitions and powerful attacks on both wings. A two-time world singles champion, he won Paris Olympic gold in 2024 to complete the Olympic, world and World Cup singles set. Leaving the world rankings did not mean retirement: he entered German club competition in 2025 and moved from Saarbrücken to Düsseldorf in 2026.
